note: Fixed, human-reviewed prompts. Never generate or change them at runtime. Neutral and non-leading on purpose: they do not presuppose distress, do not ask about self-harm, and give no advice.

prompts.text: How would you describe this past week, in your own words?
What has taken up most of your time or energy lately?
Describe a moment from the last few days that stayed with you, whether good or bad.
What are you looking forward to, or feeling unsure about, in the coming days?
How have things been with the people around you, such as friends, family or classmates?
What would you like the next few days to look like?
